facts.fact: PM-KISAN is income support of Rs 6,000 a year in three instalments, not a pension
facts.quote: Under the scheme an income support of 6,000/- per year in three equal installments will be provided to all land holding farmer families.

facts.fact: PM-KISAN is non-contributory: fully funded by the Government of India
facts.quote: PM Kisan is a Central Sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India.

facts.fact: The farmer pension is PM-KMY: a minimum assured Rs 3,000 a month from age 60
facts.quote: Under this scheme, the farmers would receive a minimum assured pension of Rs 3000/- per month after attaining the age of 60 years
It is a voluntary and contribution based pension scheme.
Those farmers who are of the age of 18 years and above and upto 40 years are eligible to join the scheme.

summary: PM-KISAN Rs 6,000 a year, 100% Centre-funded income support; PM-KMY is the contributory pension of Rs 3,000 a month from 60, entry 18-40; all confirmed.
